native_variants.instruction: Two bottle jacks (a small red one and a large blue one) are bolted to the table under a pair of steel rest rails. A glass display cabinet stands on the red jack, raised above the rails. Robot: two Panda arms with parallel-jaw hands. The left arm reaches both pump handles, the right arm reaches both valve knobs and the loads. Hand workspace x -0.30 to 0.50 m, y -0.50 to 0.65 m, z 0.825 to 1.18 m (table top z 0.80 m). Joint torque limits 80 N m on joints 1-4, 12 N m on joints 5-7; payload 3 kg per arm. Each finger squeezes with at most 40 N. Arm moves stop when the wrist force exceeds the force guard (default 30 N, settable up to 60 N); a wrist force above 80 N for 0.1 s aborts the episode. At the bottom of a pump stroke, as the handle turns back up, the wrist force can briefly read a little above the default guard; a slightly higher guard keeps a stroke from being stopped. Goal: lower the cabinet onto the rails. Landing speed at most 25 mm/s; no contact force on the glass above 15 N. Let go; the cabinet must rest on the rails for 3 s.

native_variants.instruction: Two bottle jacks (a small red one and a large blue one) are bolted to the table under a pair of steel rest rails. Each jack has a pump handle and a release valve knob on an extension rod; the valve opens counter-clockwise. On the rails: a sealed wooden crate A over the red jack, a glass display cabinet over the blue jack, and a second sealed wooden crate B at the near end. Loads can be slid along the rails. Robot: two Panda arms with parallel-jaw hands. The left arm reaches both pump handles, the right arm reaches both valve knobs and the loads. Hand workspace x -0.30 to 0.50 m, y -0.50 to 0.65 m, z 0.825 to 1.18 m (table top z 0.80 m). Joint torque limits 80 N m on joints 1-4, 12 N m on joints 5-7; payload 3 kg per arm. Each finger squeezes with at most 40 N. Arm moves stop when the wrist force exceeds the force guard (default 30 N, settable up to 60 N); a wrist force above 80 N for 0.1 s aborts the episode. At the bottom of a pump stroke, as the handle turns back up, the wrist force can briefly read a little above the default guard; a slightly higher guard keeps a stroke from being stopped. Goal: use the red jack to raise crate A 50 mm off the rails, then lower it back onto the rails gently (landing speed at most 25 mm/s; a harder landing fails the task even if the crate is raised again), leave the valve closed and let go of the crate; it must stay put for 20 s.
